presentation.label: PERFORM DIRECT
presentation.summary: PRESET toggles Perform Kit; FUNC + PRESET opens the PRESET/KIT menu.
presentation.overview: Swap two stock key combinations for quicker Perform Kit access on Digitakt II OS 1.17. There is no enable row or on-device bypass.
highlights: One press to toggle Perform Kit.
FUNC + PRESET preserves access to the PRESET/KIT menu.
No added DSP or audio-render code.
usage: Press PRESET to toggle Perform Kit.
Hold FUNC and press PRESET to open the PRESET/KIT menu.
Press NO to close the menu.

access.location: PRESET button; active whenever included in the build
steps: Boot the Digitakt II OS 1.17 build containing core-dt2 and Perform Direct.
Press PRESET without FUNC to toggle Perform Kit.
Hold FUNC and press PRESET to open the PRESET/KIT menu; close with NO.

limitations: No on-device bypass or PERSONALIZE enable row.
Another PRESET/FUNC key handler needs combination review.
Publication and firmware downloads are pending qualification.

load.conditions: Maximum project load and repeated PRESET/FUNC mode changes; no measured timing claim.

tests.summary: Actual emulator LCD captures and compiled memory accounting completed; worst-case cycles, exact-version hardware stress, owner review and browser/native parity remain pending.

license.declaration: Pinned original source from toonst/elekloader PR #38, preserving irpina and contributors copyright and GPL-2.0-or-later terms. No stock firmware imported.
